outcome: The fresh Next.js (App Router) frontend workspace is scaffolded: a developer can now run the 3F frontend (npm run dev:frontend on 127.0.0.1:3000) and build it (npm run build:frontend), themed entirely by the KnackLabs _ds tokens with locally vendored Inter (no external font requests), a TanStack Query provider, an in-tree shadcn button primitive, and a placeholder page — and the repo-wide quality gate (build + lint + format + typecheck + hermetic tests) now covers all three workspaces with the guard proving the frontend lint is effective. The user-facing shell + OTP login builds on this in frontend-shell-login.
